title: The Pawn
summary: Small but mighty — meet the pawn.

steps.text: PAWNS move straight forward — but only forward, never backward! From their starting square, they can move one OR two squares.

steps.prompt: It's the pawn's first move — slide it two squares forward to e4!
steps.retryText: This pawn hasn't moved yet, so it can go one OR two squares. Try e4.

steps.prompt: Now the pawn has already moved once, so it can only go one square at a time. Push it to e5.
steps.successText: One square at a time now — well done!
steps.retryText: This pawn already moved, so only one square is allowed. Try e5.

steps.prompt: Pawns capture diagonally, not straight ahead! Capture the pawn on d5.
steps.retryText: Pawns can only capture diagonally forward. Try capturing on d5.

steps.text: One more thing about pawns: if a pawn reaches the very last rank, it gets promoted into a new piece — usually a queen! We'll practice that in its own lesson soon.
You've now met every piece! Time to practice capturing.
